issue.title: tmux Agent — launch an interactive agent CLI in a new tmux window
issue.description: Pressing `t` in Launch Control, or running `sase tmux-agent`, opens a keyboard-first chooser of every registered agent-CLI provider and drops the chosen one into a fresh, auto-numbered tmux window in the current directory. Both surfaces share one registry-driven catalog, so a newly registered provider plugin appears with no code change here.

issue.title: tmux_agent configuration section
issue.description: config: add the `tmux_agent` config block, JSON schema entry, shipped defaults, and typed getters.

issue.title: Interactive-CLI provider descriptor
issue.description: descriptor: add the `llm_interactive_cli` hook plus vendor metadata, implement it on every built-in provider, and expose it through the registry payload.

issue.title: Catalog, launch-spec, and window-name resolution
issue.description: catalog: build the `sase.tmux_agent` package core — entry model, catalog builder, deterministic shortcut keys, launch-spec resolution, and window naming — as pure, injectable functions.

issue.title: tmux window launch, renumber, and menu rendering
issue.description: launcher: add the tmux command primitives that create the agent window, register the exit-cleanup waiter, renumber agent windows, and render the styled `display-menu`.

issue.title: sase tmux-agent command
issue.description: cli: register and dispatch the `sase tmux-agent` command with its menu, direct-launch, list, dry-run, JSON, and internal renumber paths.

issue.title: Catalog cache for menu latency
issue.description: cache: add the fingerprinted on-disk catalog cache and `-r/--refresh` so the tmux key binding renders in well under a quarter second.

issue.title: Launch Control `t` and the tmux Agent panel
issue.description: ace: bind `t` in Launch Control and add the tmux Agent modal, its styles, footer/help wiring, and behavior tests.

issue.title: Parity guarantee, visual snapshot, and documentation
issue.description: polish: pin command parity with the shell script this feature replaces, add the PNG snapshot, and write the ACE, CLI, configuration, and plugin documentation.
